tasks.title: Sync Kali's Clock with the DC
tasks.description: Kerberos rejects any request with more than ~5 minutes of clock skew (KRB_AP_ERR_SKEW). This is the #1 cause of every Kerberos-based tool (Rubeus, impacket -k, Kerbrute, evil-winrm with a ticket) silently failing — always do this before troubleshooting anything else Kerberos-related.

tasks.title: Kerbrute User Enumeration
tasks.description: Kerberos pre-auth responds differently for valid vs. invalid usernames (PRINCIPAL UNKNOWN vs. needs pre-auth), letting you validate a username list without triggering account lockouts the way a real bind attempt would. Do this before any password spraying.
